SELECT a.customeraccountid,A.PeriodBalanceTypeId, a.PeriodStartDate,a.Periodenddate, b.periodstartdate,b.end_date FROM BNKM.customeraccountperiodbalance_REMDUP_20230607 A  
LEFT JOIN (select  CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate,max(end_date) end_date ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode from (select CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode  
,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(PeriodStartDate, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ORDER BY PeriodStartDate)) as end_date
from bnkm.customeraccountperiodbalance_REMDUP_20230607 where SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Transaction Date')
c group by CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceSystemCode ) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = B.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.PeriodStartDate = B.PeriodStartDate WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
 AND A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Transaction Date'
and a.customeraccountid ='24ff7479271e6a551486b15a7491694e' order by 3

 SELECT * FROM  BNKM.customeraccountperiodbalance WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = 'PASTEHERE'
 ORDER BY PeriodBalanceTypeId, PERIODSTARTDATE

  SELECT INSERT_DTTM,FILE_NAME,* FROM  BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE WHERE ACID IN (SELECT ACID FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE FORACID = 'PASTEHERE')
 ORDER BY 1, EOD_DATE

 select * from BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL_DELTA WHERE ACID IN (SELECT ACID FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE FORACID = 'PASTEHERE')
  ORDER BY EOD_DATE


  SELECT
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BLE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BLE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BLE.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS BalanceAmount
	,BLE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BLE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BLED.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL_DELTA BLED
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL BLE 
	ON BLED.ACID = BLE.ACID 
	AND BLED.BANK_ID = BLE.BANK_ID 
	AND BLED.EOD_DATE = BLED.EOD_DATE
	AND BLE.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG 
	ON BLE.ACID = BLG.ACID 
	AND BLE.BANK_ID = BLG.BANK_ID
	AND BLG.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BLG.FORACID  = 'PASTEHERE'


SELECT
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BLE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BLE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BLE.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS BalanceAmount
	,BLE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BLE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
from BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL BLE 
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG 
	ON BLE.ACID = BLG.ACID 
	AND BLE.BANK_ID = BLG.BANK_ID
	AND BLG.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BLE.isLatest = 1 AND BLG.FORACID  = 'PASTEHERE'
